_comment: System monitor on the native `system` source — no subprocess, so it is cheap enough to keep updating in the menu bar. Percentages are 0-100. `status.label` reads `settings.*`, which is how a user chooses what the menu bar shows without editing this file. The menu bar reading is one of several (CPU total, user, system or busiest core; memory, pressure or swap; disk used, free, read or write rate), with an optional second reading as a second metric. Disk throughput is a registry walk, so `io` asks for it only when a rate is shown.

number1.from: switch(transforms.sel1, 'cpuUser', sources.data.cpu.user, 'cpuSystem', sources.data.cpu.system, 'cpuCore', sources.data.cpu.coreMax, 'memory', switch(settings.menuBarMemoryDisplay, 'used', sources.data.memory.used, 'available', sources.data.memory.free, sources.data.memory.usage), 'pressure', null, 'swap', sources.data.memory.swap.used, 'disk', sources.data.disk.usage, 'diskFree', sources.data.disk.free, 'diskRead', sources.data.disk.read, 'diskWrite', sources.data.disk.write, 'none', null, sources.data.cpu.usage)

label1.from: switch(transforms.sel1, 'cpuUser', 'CPU user', 'cpuSystem', 'CPU system', 'cpuCore', 'Busiest core', 'memory', 'Memory', 'pressure', 'Memory pressure', 'swap', 'Swap used', 'disk', 'Disk', 'diskFree', 'Disk free', 'diskRead', 'Disk read', 'diskWrite', 'Disk write', 'none', '', 'CPU')

text1.from: if(transforms.isText1, switch(sources.data.memory.pressure, 'critical', 'Critical', 'warning', 'Warning', 'normal', 'Normal', '—'), if(eq(transforms.number1, null), '—', if(eq(transforms.format1,'percent'), concat(string(round(number(transforms.number1), 0)), '%'), if(eq(transforms.format1,'bytesPerSecond'), if(lt(number(transforms.number1), 1000000), concat(string(round(div(number(transforms.number1), 1000), 0)), ' kB/s'), concat(string(round(div(number(transforms.number1), 1000000), 1)), ' MB/s')), if(gte(number(transforms.number1), 1000000000000), concat(string(round(div(number(transforms.number1), 1000000000000), 1)), ' TB'), concat(string(round(div(number(transforms.number1), 1000000000), transforms.precision1)), ' GB'))))))

tint1.from: if(transforms.isText1, switch(sources.data.memory.pressure, 'critical', 'danger', 'warning', 'warning', ''), if(gt(number(coalesce(switch(transforms.sel1, 'cpu', sources.data.cpu.usage, 'memory', sources.data.memory.usage, 'disk', sources.data.disk.usage, 'diskFree', sources.data.disk.usage, null), 0)), 90), 'danger', if(gt(number(coalesce(switch(transforms.sel1, 'cpu', sources.data.cpu.usage, 'memory', sources.data.memory.usage, 'disk', sources.data.disk.usage, 'diskFree', sources.data.disk.usage, null), 0)), 75), 'warning', '')))

number2.from: switch(transforms.sel2, 'cpuUser', sources.data.cpu.user, 'cpuSystem', sources.data.cpu.system, 'cpuCore', sources.data.cpu.coreMax, 'memory', switch(settings.menuBarMemoryDisplay, 'used', sources.data.memory.used, 'available', sources.data.memory.free, sources.data.memory.usage), 'pressure', null, 'swap', sources.data.memory.swap.used, 'disk', sources.data.disk.usage, 'diskFree', sources.data.disk.free, 'diskRead', sources.data.disk.read, 'diskWrite', sources.data.disk.write, 'none', null, sources.data.cpu.usage)

label2.from: switch(transforms.sel2, 'cpuUser', 'CPU user', 'cpuSystem', 'CPU system', 'cpuCore', 'Busiest core', 'memory', 'Memory', 'pressure', 'Memory pressure', 'swap', 'Swap used', 'disk', 'Disk', 'diskFree', 'Disk free', 'diskRead', 'Disk read', 'diskWrite', 'Disk write', 'none', '', 'CPU')

text2.from: if(transforms.isText2, switch(sources.data.memory.pressure, 'critical', 'Critical', 'warning', 'Warning', 'normal', 'Normal', '—'), if(eq(transforms.number2, null), '—', if(eq(transforms.format2,'percent'), concat(string(round(number(transforms.number2), 0)), '%'), if(eq(transforms.format2,'bytesPerSecond'), if(lt(number(transforms.number2), 1000000), concat(string(round(div(number(transforms.number2), 1000), 0)), ' kB/s'), concat(string(round(div(number(transforms.number2), 1000000), 1)), ' MB/s')), if(gte(number(transforms.number2), 1000000000000), concat(string(round(div(number(transforms.number2), 1000000000000), 1)), ' TB'), concat(string(round(div(number(transforms.number2), 1000000000), transforms.precision2)), ' GB'))))))

tint2.from: if(transforms.isText2, switch(sources.data.memory.pressure, 'critical', 'danger', 'warning', 'warning', ''), if(gt(number(coalesce(switch(transforms.sel2, 'cpu', sources.data.cpu.usage, 'memory', sources.data.memory.usage, 'disk', sources.data.disk.usage, 'diskFree', sources.data.disk.usage, null), 0)), 90), 'danger', if(gt(number(coalesce(switch(transforms.sel2, 'cpu', sources.data.cpu.usage, 'memory', sources.data.memory.usage, 'disk', sources.data.disk.usage, 'diskFree', sources.data.disk.usage, null), 0)), 75), 'warning', '')))

status.label: ${transforms.text1}
status.tooltip:
${if(transforms.plainTooltip, '', concat(transforms.label1, ' ', transforms.text1, if(transforms.hasSecond, concat(' · ', transforms.label2, ' ', transforms.text2), ''), '
'))}CPU ${string(round(number(sources.data.cpu.usage), 0))}% · Memory ${string(round(number(sources.data.memory.usage), 0))}% · Disk ${string(round(number(sources.data.disk.usage), 0))}%
